heading: Today
text: Morning fog burning off to partly sunny skies, then clouds moving in from the west. Highs from the upper 70s to near 80. Light south wind.

heading: Tonight
text: Rain showers developing in the west, then spreading east overnight. Lows in the 50s to near 60. Light and variable wind.

heading: Monday
text: Morning showers, becoming more scattered west to east in the afternoon with the chance of spotty thunderstorms. Highs from the mid to upper 70s. Light wind turning northwest near 10 mph.
